notes.title: 1.1.6 Hotfix
notes.notes:
- Teach Gungun a lesson, so that he doesn't scream every day
- Adjust some conversations
- Fill in some missing memes
- Adjust the text prompts in chat input
- Lengthens the time interval for random events
- Slightly tweaked the cat's stats value
- Optimized some UI

notes.title: 1.1.5 Major Update
notes.notes: [p]New Additions[/p][list][*][p]Added Chat Function [/p][p]Players are provided with a mobile phone, which can be used for work communication and daily chats. Try to feel the emotions of the cats during the chats! Chats may be triggered when conducting various purchase operations, during some special situations, or when reuniting after a long separation.[/p][/*][/list][p]Fixes and Optimizations[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the issue where the typing speed does not decrease when bored.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the lag problem caused by an excessively high typing speed.[/p][/*][/list]
